Name: Snoopy Dog Replacer
Author: galacticinkpen
Description:
This mod replaces the light brown dog with Snoopy. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
To install, simply unzip and drag into your Mods folder. 
Just select the light brown dog from the character creation screen, and after earning 1,000 gold, Marnie will show up with Snoopy. Don't worry if the character selection dog icon doesn't look like Snoopy! Feel free to make your farmer look like Charlie Brown or any other Peanuts character to match :)

Mods featured in screenshots:
Overgrown Flowery Interface: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166
Vibrant Pastoral Recolor: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367
